spec.rawSql:
select conflicted_file.path as submodule, case when conflicted_file.stage = 1 then 'base' when conflicted_file.stage = 2 then 'ours' else 'theirs' end as stage, conflicted_file.mode as commit from redis_json
array join content.merge_result.conflicted_files::Array(JSON) as conflicted_file
where key = 'info:conflict:core:${repo_name}:${merge}' and conflicted_file.oid = '160000'

SELECT content.duration_seconds as "Resolution Duration"
FROM "default"."redis_json"
where key = 'evaluation:merge:core:${repo_name}-${merge}:${timestamp}'

SELECT
  case
    when content.incomplete_merge = false then 1
    else 0
  end as "Complete Merge",
  case
    when content.perfect_match = false then 0
    else 1
  end as "Perfect Match"
FROM
  "default"."redis_json"
where
  key = 'evaluation:merge:core:${repo_name}-${merge}:${timestamp}'

SELECT
    fromUnixTimestamp(message.info.time.created::integer),
    CASE 
        WHEN part.type = 'text' THEN 
            part.text
        WHEN part.type = 'tool' THEN 
            concat(coalesce(part.state.title, ''), ' | Command: ', coalesce(part.state.input.command, ''))
        ELSE concat('[UNUSUAL TYPE: ', part.type, ']')
    END AS log_line,
    upper(part.type) as part_type
FROM "default"."redis_json"
array join content.hook_result.opencode_session_export.data.messages::Array(JSON) as message
array join message.parts::Array(JSON) as part
where key = 'resolution:conflict:${repo_name}-${merge}:${timestamp}'
and message.info.role = 'assistant' 
and part.type not like 'step-%'

SELECT
    fromUnixTimestamp(message.info.time.created::integer),
    CASE 
        WHEN part.tool = 'read' or part.tool = 'edit' THEN 
            basename(part.state.input.filePath)
        WHEN part.tool = 'bash' THEN 
            part.state.input.command
        ELSE concat('[UNUSUAL Tool: ', part.tool, ']')
    END AS log_line,
    part.tool as part_tool
FROM "default"."redis_json"
array join content.hook_result.opencode_session_export.data.messages::Array(JSON) as message
array join message.parts::Array(JSON) as part
where key = 'resolution:conflict:${repo_name}-${merge}:${timestamp}'
and message.info.role = 'assistant' 
and part.type = 'tool'

SELECT
  now(), content.proposed_to_actual_resolution_raw
FROM "default"."redis_json"
where key = 'evaluation:merge:diff:${repo_name}-${merge}:${timestamp}'

select key, logical_conflict.type, logical_conflict.info, logical_conflict.paths  from redis_json
array join content.merge_result.logical_conflicts::Array(JSON) as logical_conflict
where key = 'info:conflict:core:${repo_name}:${merge}'

select key, conflicted_file.path, conflicted_file.oid from redis_json
array join content.merge_result.conflicted_files::Array(JSON) as conflicted_file
where key = 'info:conflict:core:${repo_name}:${merge}' and conflicted_file.oid != '160000'

SELECT
  content.resolution_end::datetime,
  content.proposed_resolution.error
FROM "default"."redis_json"
where key = 'resolution:conflict:${repo_name}-${merge}:${timestamp}'
